chunks.heading: The Unfamiliar
chunks.notes: The chunk opens with a direct claim about crossing from ordinary into extraordinary, then runs parallel stanzas contrasting a safe, deadening cage with an unsettling but transformative unknown.

chunks.heading: The Unfamiliar
chunks.notes: This chunk narrates the physical/sensory experience of crossing and closes with an explicit, aphoristic image of the former self watching from a distance, grateful to be left behind.
